name: EPIC 210982966
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 10.5 solar radii and 1.16 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210982966 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.498733 (16th-84th percentiles 10.330794-10.687953), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210982966 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2215.625 (16th-84th percentiles 2190.703125-2240.957031), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,216 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.16 solar masses and 10.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,955 K at its surface.
